title: Practical Magic 2's Sandra Bullock, Nicole Kidman & More with Andy Cohen
summary: Listen to the full "Practical Magic 2 Front Row" on Radio Andy starting Thursday, September 10 at 10am ET.
body_markdown:
The stars of *Practical Magic 2* — Sandra Bullock, Nicole Kidman, Lee Pace, Joey King, Maisie Williams, and Xolo Marindueña — join[Andy Cohen](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/andy-cohen) for a special Front Row event.


[Radio Andy Andy & pop culture (explicit) Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-RadioAndy)


Listen to the full event on Radio Andy (Ch. 101) on car radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-RadioAndy) starting Thursday, September 10 at 10am ET. The *Practical Magic 2 Front Row* will also be available to stream on the SiriusXM app after its debut.


In the meantime, watch a clip from the exclusive special above now.
